author: win Helius

text: extremely useful, I can easily track my habits without the burden of creating a tracker myself, as I used to do on my notebooks. the reason why I didn't give five stars concerns the Pro subscription: I think it lacks an "annotation feature" . I'd like to add details to the tasks I complete during the day, such as duration, a little feedback or a reminder to get better the following days
author: Meimei Li

text: I bought Pro lifetime today. This is a piece of software I instantly liked the moment I saw it. Thank you to the developer for creating such a great app! I would like to suggest adding more widget styles in the future. You might consider taking inspiration from the widgets in the app "Loop"
